The Court made the following Order:
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, Sri Mudunuri Anand Kumar, the learned Standing Counsel for the respondent Nos.1 and 2 and the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue appearing for the respondent Nos.3 to 6.
2.

The learned Assistant Government Pleader relying upon the written instructions of the Collector and District Magistrate, Ananthapuramu dated 04.02.2026 submits that the revised award under Section 3G have been issued in respect of the lands of the concerned appellants and disbursement of compensation is under process.
The said written instructions shall be made as part of the Court record.

3. All the counsels' submit that this writ petition is squarely covered by the order of this Court in W.P.No.14957 of 2022, dated 09.12.2025.
